params.name: Value
params.note: The key of the chosen item when not Multiple (two-way: @bind-Value; ValueExpression for an EditForm).

params.name: Values
params.note: The keys of the chosen items when Multiple (two-way: @bind-Values; ValuesExpression for an EditForm).

params.name: EmptyContent
params.note: The popup's empty state; read when the popup first opens.

params.name: NoResultsContent
params.note: The popup when a search or filter matches nothing; read when the popup first opens.

params.name: Load
params.returns: new { rows = r.Items.Select(i => { var n = PkTableRows.Serialize(i, Columns); n["id"] = IdOf!(i); n["pkLabel"] = (LabelOf ?? IdOf!)(i); return n; }).ToArray(), total = r.Total }
params.doc: Loads one page of the popup table: the search, the sort, the 1-based page and the page size (PkListRequest) in, the items of that page and the total of the searched list out. A request a newer one replaces has its CancellationToken cancelled.

params.name: Resolve
params.doc: Asked once, with every key that has no label yet, to name stored keys (the element calls it, not you); returns key to label.

params.name: Columns
params.doc: The columns of the popup table.

params.name: IdOf
params.doc: The key of an item: what Value and Values hold.

params.name: LabelOf
params.doc: The text the field and the chips show for an item; default its key.

params.name: PageSize
params.note: The page size of the popup table (initial). Default 10.

params.name: Filters
params.note: Filter fields above the popup table; each value reaches Load in PkListRequest.Filters (a multiselect in MultiFilters).

notes: PkLookupPicker<TItem> (generated from this mapping) wraps pk-lookup-picker 1:1: Load and Resolve are callback properties, so the component hands the element .NET references (PkCallbackSlot) exactly as PkDataTable does; pk-lookup-select, pk-values-change and pk-lookup-toggle come back as ValueChanged, ValuesChanged and OpenChanged. Keys are strings.
